# The step index read off the relata's own courses

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-step-index-from-own-courses` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-step-index-from-own-courses.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For exchanges acting locally, an index of steps is read off the relata's own courses: it is an interleaving of them, exists exactly where a scheduler completes, reaches the configuration they fix, and is fixed by them exactly where every two exchanges share a relatum.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Equal own courses, equal configurations: with the relata listed, two lists of exchanges of a local law giving every relatum the same own course reach the same configuration from the same start, and so do two traces of the exchange process; in particular two traces interleaving the same courses end alike, and two exchanges sharing no relatum end alike in either order. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.act_comm`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.run_move`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.split_heads`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.run_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.trace_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.trace_of_interleavings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.trace_swap`)
2. The index is built: with exchanges told apart, a scheduler taking an exchange that heads the remaining course of every relatum it touches completes, within as many stages as the courses have exchanges, exactly where some list, or some trace of the exchange process, takes every relatum through its given course; what it returns does so. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ready`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.pick`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.pop`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.schedule`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.pop_interleaves`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_pop`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.schedule_interleaves`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.schedule_some`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.schedule_iff`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.traced_iff`)
3. Where the courses fix the index: with the relata listed, equal own courses force equal lists of exchanges exactly where every exchange touches some relatum and every two exchanges are the same or share a relatum, and the same holds for the traces from any one configuration; two exchanges sharing no relatum have the same own courses in either order. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.Connected`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.swap_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.eq_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.unique_iff`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.traced_unique_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each theorem states what it needs: a local law of exchange (LocalLaw: an exchange leaves the relata it does not touch as they were and changes a relatum it touches as the states of the relata it touches determine); the relata listed, for the configuration and uniqueness laws; exchanges told apart (decided equality), for the scheduler. Courses are finite lists.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That every becoming has a local law of exchange: whether a becoming can be so represented is the warrant question of the scope of representation, which stays open.
- Separate footprints for reading and changing: here what an exchange reads and what it may change are one footprint, so two reads of one relatum do not commute.
- Courses without end, and a join by definition to the footprint of Becoming.Order over a world's steps; nor the other identification of block A, of conditions with relata.
- **Counterexample:** Where two exchanges share no listed relatum, [e, f] and [f, e] have the same own courses; where they are distinct the two lists differ, so the own courses do not fix the index (unique_iff, forward direction). An exchange touching nothing has the same own courses as the empty list. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interleavings.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The open programme of the chapter left open "deriving the shared index of steps from relations, or saying why it is a commitment of the representation". Ren, 18 October 2026: "currently i have no problem of heading to your direction ... please continue" (provenance of the work, not its warrant). The result answers the formal half for finite courses of a local law: the index is derived where every two exchanges share a relatum and is otherwise a choice the configurations do not read. This is the converse direction of Mazurkiewicz traces (Mazurkiewicz 1977; Cartier and Foata 1969): there a trace is the class of words under commuting independent letters; here the class is given by its projections to the relata and the scheduler builds a representative. Reading (the AI's, taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): the shared index of steps is a reading of the relations, not their ground.

There, for a world given with an index and a footprint, the order of joined exchanges is what the premises keep; here, with no index given, the index is built from the own courses and carries nothing beyond them.
- related, not a proved adapter: [only-the-order-of-change-registers](only-the-order-of-change-registers.md). There renumberings keeping the order of joined exchanges keep every premise of a world; here interleavings of the same own courses reach the same configuration.
